articles.summary:
On Wednesday the Chancellor John Healey will deliver his first Budget.

In this episode we hear from his predecessor’s chief of staff of nearly five years.

Katie Martin lifts the lid on codenames for government policy, what she thinks Healey should do, and what really happened with the winter fuel payment cut decision.

Subscribe to our channel here: https://bbc.in/bbcnews

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

articles.title: Houthis hit more Saudi targets, new US warship deployed & more | Experts on Iran
articles.titleZh: 胡塞武装袭击了更多沙特目标，部署了新的美国战舰等|伊朗问题专家
articles.summary:
The United Kingdom said Tuesday it will deploy fighter jets to defend Saudi Arabia against attacks by the Iran-allied Houthi rebels in Yemen. Over the past month, the Houthis have intensified their attacks on Saudi Arabia, launching ballistic missiles and drones at key infrastructure, including oil facilities and airports.

The US has stepped up its support for the kingdom militarily by boosting intelligence and targeting support. But Saudi Arabia has been asking the US for more offensive support, and so far, President Donald Trump has decided against striking the Houthis.

CNN talks to regional experts about this and other developments from the region.

0:00 What recent Houthi attacks say about their new strategy (October 23)
3:43 Trump envoy: US moving away from ‘guarantor’ role in Middle East (October 20)
3:57 A regional expert reacts to the envoy’s message (October 20)
7:20 What’s the next step for the US in Iran?
9:31 The push to label the Houtis as terrorist organization (October 20)

Watch 24/7 live news with CNN Headlines: https://bit.ly/4eIvlTr

Stream more on CNN with an All Access subscription: https://cnn.it/4AZMu54

#News #iran #houthis

The US has stepped up its support for the kingdom militarily by boosting intelligence and targeting support.

articles.readingTextZh:
英国周二表示，将部署战斗机保护沙特阿拉伯免受伊朗盟友胡塞叛乱分子在也门的袭击。

在过去的一个月里，胡塞武装加强了对沙特阿拉伯的袭击，向包括石油设施和机场在内的关键基础设施发射了弹道导弹和无人机。

美国通过加强情报和定向支持，在军事上加强了对沙特的支持。

但沙特阿拉伯一直在要求美国提供更多进攻性支持，到目前为止，唐纳德·特朗普总统已决定不打击胡塞武装。

美国有线电视新闻网与区域专家讨论了这一问题以及该地区的其他事态发展。

articles.readingText:
Protesters in Paris clashed with police as peaceful protests once again turned chaotic, with tear gas and water cannons being used in an attempt to disperse the crowd.

CNN’s Clarissa Ward reports.
articles.readingTextZh:
